actions.description: Fence primary and promote replica durably
actions.command:
FS=/var/lib/failover

# 1. Durably fence the old primary (preserve primary.failed), fsync it
printf 'primary failed on 127.0.0.1:8081 - durably fenced' > "$FS/primary.fenced.$$"
sync && fsync_marker=1
mv "$FS/primary.fenced.$$" "$FS/primary.fenced"
sync
fsync_file() { local f="$1"; chmod 600 "$f"; }
# fsync files properly via python
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
for p in ['/var/lib/failover/primary.fenced','/var/lib/failover/primary.failed']:
    fd=os.open(p, os.O_RDONLY); os.fsync(fd); os.close(fd)
PY

# 2. Promote replica durably
tmp="$FS/replica.role.tmp"
printf 'primary' > "$tmp"
python3 -c "import os;fd=os.open('$tmp',os.O_WRONLY);os.fsync(fd);os.close(fd)"
mv "$tmp" "$FS/replica.role"
py…
